Pit traps and breaking floors in tombs are collapsing after 20 seconds, giving you more time to react. If you find the tomb breaking floors too hard to solve, or you are annoyed by pit traps in the overworld, now they collapse after 20 seconds, not 0.5 or 4 as before.
Troubleshooting: https://dysmantle.fandom.com/wiki/Modding
